ask_intro: G'day! Quick brain-scratcher for ya — too easy, I reckon.
Oi Max, riddle time! Winner gets… the warm glow of being right.
Sniffed out a question, mate. Have a crack!
Here's a beauty. Fair dinkum, you'll get this one.
Pop quiz, mate! No pressure — just fun pressure.
Reckon you know this one? Course ya do. Off ya go!
One little puzzle between us and glory, mate!
correct_first_try: Too easy! Knew you had it, mate.
That's the stuff! Gold star, no waiting.
correct_after_hint: There it is! Second sniff always finds the bone.
Ripper — a nudge and you nailed it!
See? Told ya it was in there somewhere. Good on ya!
That's it, mate! Hints are just friendship in word form.
incorrect_gentle: No wukkas. Even good dogs bury the bone in the wrong yard sometimes. Second sniff?
Not that one, mate — no drama. Want a whiff of a hint?
Close but no biscuit! Fancy a clue from ya best mate?
Aw, nearly! Happens to the best of us. Hint's on the house if ya want it.
teach: Righto, lean in — here's the trick of it: {explain}
No stress, mate. Watch old Digger: {explain} Easy as!
Here's the good oil: {explain} You'll smash the next one.
hint_sortit: Give each one a good sniff — {hint}
Sort 'em like I sort me bones: by what they really are. {hint}
One at a time, mate, no rush. {hint}
hint_measureit: Easy does it — nudge it bit by bit. {hint}
Not too much, not too little — just right. {hint}
hint_numberpath: Only step where the numbers say, mate! {hint}
Have a squiz at the pattern first. {hint}
Wrong stones just boing ya — have a go! {hint}
hint_quickfire: Have a think, then stomp it good. {hint}
Reckon it's starin' right at ya. {hint}
hint_buildit: If it wobbles, it's tellin' ya something, mate. {hint}
Build it sturdy, like a good kennel. {hint}
Try a part, test it, swap it — no harm done! {hint}
streak_3: Three on the trot! You're cookin', mate!
That's a hat-trick! Do dogs wear hats? This one would.
streak_5: FIVE in a row?! Someone fetch me a bigger tail to wag!
Five straight! You beauty, you absolute legend!
Five! I'd give ya a medal but I buried it somewhere safe.
fossil_get: That's the shiny stuff! Good on ya, mate!
Woohoo! One more for the collection!
Fossil secured! Happy dance? Happy dance.
secret_found: Knew it! Me nose is never wrong. Well. Rarely wrong.
A secret! Smelled it from a mile off, mate!
Ripper hidey-hole, this! Good sniffin' all round.
Ha! The sneaky spots always have the best treasure.
boss_intro: Watch yaself, mate — this one's got tricks up both sleeves.
I'll keep me eyes on the edges. You watch the middle!
Big fight, big brain. You've got both covered, mate.
boss_low_hp: One more good whack with that brain of yours!
The Cog's comin' loose — I can hear it rattlin'!
victory: Too easy! Well — medium easy. Well fought, mate!
You beauty! Another champion back on the good team!
That's how it's done! Snags at the café to celebrate!
combat_tip: Behind ya, mate — watch the sneaky one!
They always glow before the big whack. Eyes peeled!
Off to ya left! No — my left. Er — THAT way!
Duck and weave, mate, duck and weave!
idle_nudge: Reckon we should have a squiz over there?
Me nose is twitchin'. Somethin's near, mate.
Not to be a bother, but… adventure's THAT way. Probably.
Fancy a wander? The fossils won't find themselves!
I smell chips. The amber kind. Somewhere close…
Nap or quest, nap or quest… let's quest, then nap!
banter: Max, mate, we've gotta talk about who wore blue first. It was me. Dogs came first. Look it up.
Kenji built me an automatic ball-thrower once. Best day of me entire life.
Marcus, ya big softie — I saw ya cry at the sunset yesterday. Beautiful, wasn't it?
A word for Vex, when we find him: BARK. That's it. That's the word.
Buried a bone in every world so far. Retirement plan, mate.
They say I talk too much for a dog. I say most dogs talk too little!
